references.text: The same age requirement (30–50 years) for the Levites' service is mentioned earlier in the same chapter regarding Kohath's sons.
An identical age requirement applies to Gershon's sons, who were also to serve at the tent of meeting.
The same age limits are confirmed in the summary of the census of Merari's sons.
The Levites' service age is specified here as starting from 25 years, with retirement at 50, a parallel text concerning the period of Levitical service.
David counts the Levites from 30 years and upward, in accordance with the instructions in Numbers.
The age limit was changed to 20 years under David, but refers back to the original arrangement.
Women who served at the entrance to the tent of meeting show that service at the tabernacle was organized.
